name: com.hyxen.privateadlocus.AdActivity
description: The HyXen AdLocus private ad SDK opens this page for in-app ads and ad-notification taps; it shows the ad page or opens the advertised link, and also handles the SDK's ad-setting prompt.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents AdLocus ads, their landing pages, and related notification controls from opening; the host app's other screens remain available.
